title: #BeInclusive - Sport for Peace
description: Scope: To reward projects using sport as a vehicle to promote peace and European values. This category would particularly target initiatives promoting the inclusion of refugees, such as in the context of the war in Ukraine.
budgetMeaning: Source budget field; not an award or guaranteed per-project amount
